subject: design/feature-draft-reopen
statement: Brainstorm records, review reports, and requirement problems continue the feature's numbering across versions (`design-brainstorm:feature-draft-tech-design-2#D-2`). Readiness refuses, as an invalid part (`prd:feature-draft/UB-7`), a working file whose number the feature already used, naming the next free number. It refuses any PRD or tech-spec row that reuses an ID an earlier version retired the same way: requirement IDs are stable and never reused (`#F-8`), and question, risk, and decision rows compile to per-feature families just as requirements do.
